name: Fractera Config
shortDescription: The project settings of the node as its own element: APP, PLATFORM and DESIGN settings and the menu live here, the architect edits them here, every element reads them here.
longDescription: The source of the project settings for the whole node: APP, PLATFORM and DESIGN settings and the menu. The architect edits them on the pages /<lang>/architect/*; every element of the node reads them over MCP (/mcp: settings_version, get_project_settings, subscribe) with the node key, and after a save this element signals every subscribed address (POST {version} with X-Settings-Key). Defaults live in settings/<kind>/defaults.json, the owner patch in data/settings/<kind>.json.
accepts: The node key (X-Settings-Key) to read; the architect session (through the node sign-in element) to write.
returns: The project settings: { ok, kind, defaults, patch, config } — config is the owner patch over the defaults.
